info.title: 4Partners Site API
info.description:
The API of a 4Partners partner site: catalog, content and settings of the site, orders of the partner paid from its deposit, and the path of a customer from sign-in to an order.

- **Requests.** Every operation is `POST /v2/<group>/<entity>/<action>` with a JSON body; an operation without parameters takes `{}`. Keys are `snake_case`, ids go in the body, an unknown key gives 422.
- **Authorization.** The site token in `X-Auth-Token` (issued in the partner account). Customer groups (`customer-account`, `customer-cart`, `customer-order`) take the customer token in `X-Customer-Auth-Token`, issued by `customer-auth` with the site token: it is valid for an hour, `customer-auth/refresh` renews it with the one-time refresh token (30 days), `customer-auth/sign-out` ends the sign-in. Customer tokens stop working after a password change or reset and when the site token that issued them is disabled. Dictionaries accept either token; other operations read only `X-Auth-Token`. A wrong kind of token gives 403 `customer-token-required` or `site-token-required`.
- **Responses.** A JSON envelope `{timestamp, error, data, meta}`; a field without a value is `null`. Money is a decimal string (`"65095.00"`), country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (`RU`).
- **Errors.** `application/problem+json` with a stable `type` to branch on, `detail` and `pointer` to the wrong value.
- **Language.** The language of data (product names, characteristics, rubrics, countries, articles) is set by `site_variation` in the body: the code of a site variation from `settings/site-variation/list`, the default variation when omitted. `Accept-Language: en` or `ru` (English by default) sets only the language of error texts (`detail`).
- **Limits.** 600 requests per minute (sliding window) for each group, counted per site: all tokens of the site share one counter; in customer groups — per customer. The state is in `meta.usage` and `X-RateLimit-*` headers; over the limit — 429 with `Retry-After`.
- **For AI agents.** `/v2/llms.txt` — groups and operations one line each; `/v2/llms-full.txt` — every operation with its body fields, response fields and error types, in Markdown.

post.description: Operations of the deposit of the site owner, newest first, page by page (`meta.pager`): charges for orders paid with `order/pay`, refunds for orders, vouchers, top-ups and corrections by an operator. The amount is signed: a charge is negative. Canceling an order does not return the deposit: a refund is made by an operator and comes as `order_refund`. Filters: `currency`, `type`, `date_from` and `date_to` (days, inclusive).

currency.description: Only operations in this currency: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR`.

date_from.description: Only operations made on this day or later, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

date_to.description: Only operations made on this day or earlier, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

post.summary: List brands with products on the site
post.description: Brands that have products on the site by the search index, page by page (`meta.pager`), with `product_count` — the same selection as `stock/product/search` and `stock/facet/list`: restrictions of the site, the delivery country of `site_variation` (or `country`), `in_stock`, with `rubric_id` — products of the rubric with its subrubrics. So `product_count` equals `meta.pager.total` of `stock/product/search` with `brand_ids: [id]` and the same fields. `meta.cache.brand_product_counts.generated_at` tells when these counts were calculated; `expires_at` — when the 120-second cache expires. Brands closed for the site by the platform and brands hidden by the partner are left out (hidden ones — `brand/list-denied`); a brand without products — `brand/search`. `sort`: by name (default) or by the number of products. A rubric not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

requestBody.description: Request: list brands with products on the site.

rubric_id.description: Only brands with products in this rubric of the site rubric tree (`rubric/list`), with its subrubrics; a rubric of another tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`.

in_stock.description: Count only products in stock by the search index, as `in_stock` of `stock/product/search`. False — also products without stock, but only if the site shows them (`shows_out_of_stock_products` of `settings/info/show`).

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): its delivery country decides which products are on the site; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, as `country` of `stock/product/search`.

error.description: Always `false` in a successful response; `true` in an error (`application/problem+json`).

post.description: Changes texts of the brand on the site by locale and its templates. An omitted or `null` field stays as it is; an empty string (or only spaces) resets the text to `null`; spaces around values are trimmed. `doc_template_id`/`layout_template_id` 0 removes the assignment. The description is HTML and is shown on the storefront as is, without sanitizing. The shared brand catalogue does not change; the cache of the site is reset, so the storefront shows the new texts at once. Each locale at most once in `translations`; a locale of another site or a repeated one gives 422 at `#/translations/<i>/locale`, a template of another site or of a wrong kind — 422 at its field, no text and no template — 422.

The change is written in one transaction: a refusal leaves the article as it was.

post.description: A token for a customer without an account (an app before sign-in): in `X-Customer-Auth-Token` it opens only `customer-cart/show` and `customer-cart/item/*`, other customer operations give 403 `customer-token-required`. The cart lives as long as the token, 90 days; renew it before with `guest_token`, the new token keeps the cart. To place an order the guest signs in or up with a code — `customer-auth/sign-in` by `phone` (SMS) or `customer-auth/sign-up` by `email` (the password is optional), then `customer-auth/confirm` with `guest_token`: the guest cart moves to the customer. A code is required because an order on an unconfirmed phone or email would show the order to the owner of that phone or email.

post.description: Saves the address, payment method and the delivery method (with the pick-up point) of one package; omitted fields stay. Every value is checked against the current checkout: an unknown package — 404 on `package_id`; a method the package does not have — 422 on `delivery_method_id`; a point not in `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list` of the method or a point for a courier method — 422 on `pick_up_point_id`; a payment method not in `payment_methods` — 422 on `payment_method_id`; an address of another customer — 404 on `address_id`. The address is saved first: packages and methods depend on it. The order notifications go to the email of the address (the email of the customer if the address has none): change it with `customer-account/address/update`. Returns the recalculated checkout.

post.description: Delivery options for the items to the country (and city) of the recipient, priced as `order/create` will charge them; nothing is saved. Takes the same `items`, `country`, `currency`, `city_id` (`recipient.city_id` of the order) and `pick_up_point_id` as `order/create`: check the cart here, then order with the chosen `delivery_method_id`. Every delivery method of the site is in `options` (priced, cheapest first) or in `omitted` with the reason: `city_required` — a pick-up method without `city_id` or `pick_up_point_id`; `no_pick_up_points`; `too_heavy`; `country_not_served`; `warehouse_not_served` — a method must ship from the warehouses of all items at once, so a mixed-warehouse cart gets fewer methods (split it); `city_not_served` — Crimea and Sevastopol; `not_priced` — the tariff does not take an item (tyres). A pick-up method with `city_id` is priced at the most expensive point of the city (`price_is_upper_bound: true`); with `pick_up_point_id` — to that point. `delivery_date` is text for display, `delivery_date_iso` — the same date as `YYYY-MM-DD`; `weight_grams` — the weight the tariff priced. A price of `"0.00"` is valid. Rejected with 422 and `pointer`: a country the site does not deliver to (`country-not-delivered`), a currency the site has not for the country, a variation not sold on the site (`variation-unavailable`), a quantity above the stock (as in `order/create`: products are not bought to order), an item no tariff of the site can carry (`delivery-unavailable`), an inactive pick-up point.

post.description: Active pick-up points of a pick-up delivery method in a settlement, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`; the same point model as `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`. `city_id` is the KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`; points are taken in steps: the city, if it has none — its district, then its region (`city_id` of each point shows where it is). `min_latitude`, `min_longitude`, `max_latitude`, `max_longitude` narrow it to the frame of a map. With the cart (`product_variation_ids` and `quantities`, as `items` of `delivery/calculate`) each point of the page has `price` — what `order/create` with this `pick_up_point_id` charges for the delivery; without it `price` is `null`. Pass the chosen `id` as `pick_up_point_id` to `delivery/calculate` and `order/create`. A method that is not enabled on the site gives 422 `delivery-method-not-on-site`, a door method — 422 `pick-up-not-supported`, both with `pointer` `#/delivery_method_id`.

delivery_method_id.description: Pick-up delivery method id (`with_pick_up_points` in `dictionary/delivery-method/list`, `type: pick_up_point` in `delivery/calculate`).

city_id.description: Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`, the same as `city_id` of `delivery/calculate` and `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`.

min_latitude.description: Map frame: south latitude. The frame filters only when all four bounds are passed.

product_variation_ids.description: Cart to price the delivery to each point of the page, as `items` of `delivery/calculate`: product variation ids, quantities — in `quantities` at the same positions. Without it `price` is `null`.

quantities.description: Quantities of `product_variation_ids` at the same positions, 1 to 1000; omitted — 1 of each.

currency.description: Currency of `price`: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR` that the site sells in for Russia; by default the primary one.

error.description: Always `false` in a successful response; `true` in an error (`application/problem+json`).

post.description: Settlements of a delivery country of the site by a part of the name, paginated: the page is in `meta.pager`. In Russia the source is the KLADR directory (without Crimea and Sevastopol, where the site does not deliver): names that start with `query` come first, then the other matches, larger settlements higher; `е` and `ё` are the same. `id` is the KLADR id: pass it as `city_id` to `delivery/calculate`, `delivery/pick-up-point/list` and `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`. A country the site does not deliver to gives 422 `country-not-delivered` with `pointer` `#/country`.

query.description: Beginning or part of the settlement name, at least 2 characters, in any case; in Russia `е` also finds `ё` (`Орел` finds `Орёл`).

country.description: Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from `dictionary/country/list`, in any case; by default the primary country of the site.

post.description: Places an order on behalf of the partner (the site owner) and returns it with `deposit_due`, the amount `order/pay` will charge. Prices may not be lower than the site prices (422 `/api/problems/price-below-site-price`); the quantity of a line may not exceed the stock of the product on the site (422, `pointer` to the quantity): products are not bought to order; an offer whose supplier does not pass stock (`quantity: 99` in `stock/*`) is not limited; `pick_up_point_id` must be a pick-up point of the delivery method; `currency` must be one the site has for the recipient country (422 `#/currency`). Use the same `country`, `recipient.city_id` (KLADR) and `pick_up_point_id` as in `delivery/calculate`: the delivery is charged as it showed. No passport is needed to place the order: when customs need one, the package has `passport_status` and `passport_link` — send the link to the recipient, who fills in the passport. A repeated request with the same `external_id` and the same body returns the order already created with status 200 and `replayed: true`; a different body gives 409 `/api/problems/external-id-conflict`. Business rule violations give 422 with the reason in `detail`, its own `type` where the client may act on it and `pointer` to the value of the body; a site owner not allowed to place orders on the site gives 403 `/api/problems/owner-not-allowed`.

post.description: Accepts linking of up to 1000 products to rubrics of the site tree and to all their ancestors, so a product of a subrubric is shown in the parent rubrics too. Any product of the common catalog can be linked, not only one already on the site: this is how the partner builds the assortment of the site — a product linked to the site tree becomes a product of the site (find products to add in a source store: rubrics — `source/store-rubric/list`, their products — `stock/product/id/list` with `store_id` and `rubric_id`). Unknown product ids are returned in `rejected_product_ids` and skipped; a rubric not in the site tree rejects the whole request (422 `rubric-not-in-tree`), as does a request without a single known product (422 `no-products-accepted`).

post.description: Rubrics of the site tree ordered by level, position and id, page by page (`meta.pager`): the whole tree, the children of `parent_id` or all its descendants (`with_descendants`), or only `ids`. Each row carries what a menu and breadcrumbs need, so the whole menu is built from this list without `rubric/show` per rubric: the menu flags (`in_top_menu`, `in_all_menu`, `in_footer_menu`, `unfold`, `unfold_count`), `local_name` in the language of `site_variation` and `ancestors` from the root. `active` is the own flag of the rubric: a child of an inactive rubric can be `true`, the storefront hides it with the parent. `product_count` — products of the site in the rubric with its subrubrics by the search index, as `stock/product/search` finds them; `non_empty=true` leaves out rubrics without products. Translations, description and meta are in `rubric/show`. A `parent_id` not in the site tree gives 422 `rubric-not-in-tree`, `with_descendants` without `parent_id` — 422.

post.description: Products of the site found in the search index by text, rubric, brands, aspect values (`param_ids`: OR inside one aspect, AND between aspects), price, stock and discount, page by page (`meta.pager`), in the format of `stock/product/show`: prices and stock are current, not from the index. Every page is exactly the window of the index: a product the index has in stock but the live data does not comes with `available: false` instead of dropping out, so pages are full and their sum is `meta.pager.total`. A product closed for the site after the last indexing comes with `closed: true`; only a product unlinked from the site tree after the last indexing is left out, until the next indexing. The storefront hides a product with `available: false` itself; a product without `variations` cannot be sold now. With `sort` by price, products without a current price (`min_price: null`) go last on each page. A product added since the last indexing is not found yet: `stock/product/id/list` reads the database. Facets of the same selection (values with counts, brands, price range) — `stock/facet/list`. Pages go down to 10 000 products: to get all products use `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/batch-show`.

post.description: A product card of the site: name and description in the language of `site_variation` when translated (`locale`), `url` of the page on the site, main `image`, `min_price`, aspects with their `role` and variations. The price of a variation comes from the best active offer of the site for the country at the time of the request — the same offer `order/create` takes — and is the same as in `stock/list`. A product without `variations` (no variation has images and an offer) cannot be sold now: `available: false`, `min_price: null`. A variation that cannot be ordered has `available: false`, stock 0 and `unavailable_reason`; its price stays when there is an offer (`out_of_stock`, `price_over_limit`, `weight_over_limit`) and is `null` without one (`no_offer`). What is the same for all variations (`currency`, `url`, shared properties) is given once on the product. Money is a decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`), country codes are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case. A product of the site tree closed for the site (country, brand or rubric restrictions, a manual denial) comes with `closed: true` and no `variations`; a product not in the site tree gives 404.

post.description: Up to `limit` products for the search box while the customer types, by the same search as the storefront drop-down (name, brand, article; the search method of the site), in the format of `stock/product/show`. For the full result use `stock/product/search` with the same text. Fewer than 2 characters give 422.

query.description: Text being typed, at least 2 characters.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the search and of names, prices and stock; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the delivery country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: prices and stock for this country.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`) of the article in the response; omitted, `null` or `default` — the default variation. The flag itself is common to all variations.

rubric_id.description: Rubric id.

code.description: Promo code of the site, case does not matter.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.

currency.description: Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.

locale.description: Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

name.description: Tag: pass it in `tags` of `content/article/create`/`update` or as `tag` of `content/article/list`.

article_count.description: Articles of the site with this tag in the variation.

id.description: Type id: pass it as `article_type_id` to `content/article/update`.

name.description: Name of the type (Russian, as in the admin panel).

article_id.description: Article of the site that has this type now; `null` — none, the storefront shows its default page.

name.description: Title.

slug.description: URL slug, unique in the site.

url.description: Absolute URL of the article on the storefront of the site variation: `https://<host>[/<variation folder>]/a-<slug>`; a page of a type has its own address (main — `/`, 404 — `/error404`, …). The page opens by this URL even when the article is inactive.

doc_type.description: Format of the article: `html` — HTML document (`html`, `styles`, `scripts`); `markdown` — Markdown source (`markdown`), the HTML is built from it; `block` — made in the block editor of the admin panel, read-only here.

article_type_id.description: Type of the page (`content/article-type/list`: main page, 404, …); `null` — an ordinary article. A page of a type is not deleted.

publish_date.description: Publication date, ISO 8601 with the offset of the platform time zone (`2026-11-05T13:00:00+03:00`); `null` — not set.

active.description: Shown in the lists and menus of the site. An inactive article stays available by its direct URL.

has_text.description: The article has its text (meta, tags, document) in the requested site variation. In `content/article/list` an article without it gives `false` and empty variation fields; `show` of such an article gives 404.

rubric_ids.description: Rubrics of the site tree in order; the first is the main one.

tags.description: Public tags of the article in the variation (`content/tag/list`).

tags_relink.description: Manual relinking: `A123` product, `R123` rubric, `B123` brand — what `tags_relink` of `create`/`update` sets.

tags_relink_auto.description: Automatic relinking from product widgets of a Markdown article, rebuilt on each change of `markdown`; read-only. A manual link to the same object replaces the automatic one.

html.description: HTML of the document, output on the storefront as is, without sanitizing; for a Markdown article — built from `markdown`. `null` in `content/article/list` (the list has no document) and when the document has no HTML.

styles.description: CSS of the document; `null` in `content/article/list` and when not set.

scripts.description: JavaScript of the document, run on the storefront as is; `null` in `content/article/list` and when not set.

settings.description: Page settings of the document, a JSON object (an empty object nested in it comes back as `[]`); `null` in `content/article/list` and when not set.

context.description: Block settings of the document, a JSON object (an empty object nested in it comes back as `[]`); `null` in `content/article/list` and when not set.

markdown.description: Markdown: the source of a Markdown article or the text version of an HTML article (served at `markdown_url`); `null` in `content/article/list` and when there is none.

markdown_url.description: URL of the Markdown version on the site; `null` — the article has no Markdown.

meta_robots.description: Meta robots, one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW`; `null` — not set (the storefront uses `INDEX, FOLLOW`).

preview_text.description: Preview text for lists; `null` — not set.

og_image.description: Open Graph image URL; `null` — not set.

items.description: Cart lines. The quantity of a variation (summed over lines) may not exceed its stock on the site.

country.description: Destination country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from `dictionary/country/list`, in any case (`ru` and `RU` are the same).

city_id.description: Settlement KLADR id (Russia) from `dictionary/city/search`, the same as `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`.

pick_up_point_id.description:
Pick-up point id from `delivery/pick-up-point/list`: the pick-up method of its network is priced to this point,
as `order/create` with this `pick_up_point_id` is charged. Without `city_id` the city of the point is used.

currency.description: Price currency: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR` that the site sells in for `country`; by default the primary currency of the site for it. A currency the site has not for the country gives 422 `#/currency` with the allowed ones.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language of the names in the response; the default variation if omitted.

id.description: Settlement KLADR id (11 digits) in Russia: pass it as `city_id` to `delivery/calculate`, `delivery/pick-up-point/list` and `recipient.city_id` of `order/create`. `null` in other countries: there is no directory, pass the name as text (`recipient.city`).

name.description: Name: a city by itself (`Москва`), a smaller settlement with its district and type (`Ибресинский р-н, п. Орел`); outside Russia — the name the geocoder found.

country.description: Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case.

confirmation_id.description: `confirmation_id` from `customer-auth/sign-in` (`phone:123`) or `customer-auth/sign-up` (`email:` and 32 hex characters); the email one works only with the code of its own sign-up.

code.description: Code from the SMS or the email.

guest_token.description: Guest token of `customer-auth/guest`: the guest cart moves to the customer after the sign-in.

name.description: Banner name from the editor.

link.description: Where the banner leads, as set in the editor: a storefront address (open it with `stock/product/show` `url`, `brand/show` `slug` or a search) or an external link.

medium.description: WebP for a phone screen at 2x.

large.description: WebP for a desktop screen at 2x.

title.description: Title: the header above a product slider in the article.

products.description: Products of a `product_slider` in the format of `stock/product/show`.

products_url.description: Storefront address the slider takes its products from — the «see all» link: open it as a search.

article_id.description: Article id (`content/article/show`); `null` — the site has no such article or no variation of it.

blocks.description: Blocks in the order of the article; other block types of the editor are left out.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code in upper case, e.g. `RU`: pass it as `country`.

name.description: Country name in the requested language, e.g. `Russia`.
Title, no HTML.

doc_type.description: Format of the article: `html` (default) — pass the document in `html`, `styles`, `scripts`, `settings`, `context`; `markdown` — pass the source in `markdown`, the HTML is built from it (the document fields are not accepted), product widgets of the Markdown fill `tags_relink_auto`.

html.description: HTML of the document (`doc_type` `html`). The storefront outputs it as is, without sanitizing (scripts and styles included): pass only markup you trust.

markdown.description: Markdown: the source of a Markdown article (`doc_type` `markdown`, required), or an optional text version of an HTML article served at `markdown_url`.

scripts.description: JavaScript of the document (`doc_type` `html`), run on the storefront as is.

settings.description: Page settings of the document (`doc_type` `html`), a JSON object.

context.description: Block settings of the document (`doc_type` `html`), a JSON object.

publish_date.description: Publication date, ISO 8601: `2026-11-05T10:00:00+03:00`, `2026-11-05T07:00:00Z`; seconds and fractions are optional (`2026-11-05T10:00`), without an offset — the platform time zone (Europe/Moscow). Stored in the platform time zone: the response gives the same moment with `+03:00`. Omitted — not set.

slug.description: URL slug, unique in the site; omitted or empty — made from `name`, a taken one gets a suffix (`-two`). A taken slug passed explicitly gives 422.

active.description: Shown in the lists and menus of the site; omitted — `true`: the article is published at once.

meta_robots.description: Meta robots: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); empty — not set (the storefront uses `INDEX, FOLLOW`).

preview_text.description: Preview text for lists; empty — not set.

tags.description:
Public tags of the article in the variation, no commas (`content/tag/list`); a new tag is added to the
dictionary, repeats are dropped.

tags_relink.description:
Manual relinking: `A123` product, `R123` rubric of the site tree, `B123` brand; repeats are dropped. An
unknown product or brand, a rubric of another tree — 422 on the item.

rubric_ids.description: Rubrics of the site tree (`rubric/list`) in order, the first is the main one; repeats are dropped.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): the meta, tags and document are written for it; omitted, `null` or `default` — the default variation.

product_variation_id.description: Product variation id from `variations[].id` of `stock/product/show` (or `stock/list`); a variation without stock gives 422.

quantity.description: Quantity to set for the variation (not added to the quantity already in the cart); more than the stock gives 422 with the stock in `detail`.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.

currency.description: Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.

locale.description: Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.

currency.description: Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.

locale.description: Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

return_url.description:
Where the payment page sends the customer after the bank: a deep link of the app (`myapp://orders`) or an
`https` page. `order_id` and `payment_status` (`paid`, `pending` — the bank accepted it, the confirmation is on
its way, poll `customer-order/show`; `failed`) are added to its query. Without it the customer stays on the
payment page of the site.

kind.description: Kind: a page type (`rubric` — catalog pages, rubrics and brands; `product` — product card) or `layout` — a wrapper of the page with `{{ content }}` in `html`.

name.description: Template name, no HTML.

html.description: HTML with block placeholders `<template data-block-id="N">`; a layout needs `{{ content }}` — the page is inserted there (without it — 422). Output on the storefront as is, without sanitizing.

context.description: Settings and bindings of the blocks, a JSON object: `{"blocks": {"N": {"props": …, "binding": …}}}`.

active.description: Active: an inactive template is skipped on the storefront; omitted — `true`.

pick_up_point_id.description:
Pick-up point id from `delivery/pick-up-point/list` of this delivery method, for pick-up delivery methods only
(a door method gives 422 `pick-up-not-supported`). Pass it: the delivery is charged to this point, as
`delivery/calculate` with the same `pick_up_point_id` showed. Without it the point is chosen only on a site with
a default pick-up point in its settings (the point nearest to the address, or that default one); otherwise 422
`pick-up-point-required`.

external_id.description:
Order id in the partner system, makes the request safe to retry after a timeout. A repeated request with
the id of a live (not canceled) order and the same items, `delivery_method_id`, `pick_up_point_id` and
`currency` returns that order with status 200 and `replayed: true`; a different body gives 409
`/api/problems/external-id-conflict`. The recipient is not compared. An empty or blank value is the same
as no id: the order is created without it and is never replayed.

currency.description: Order currency: `RUB`, `USD` or `EUR` that the site sells in for the recipient country; by default the primary currency of the site for it. Another currency gives 422 `#/currency` with the allowed ones, before anything is saved.

order.description: The order: placed by this request or, when `replayed`, by an earlier one with the same `external_id`.

replayed.description:
`true` — the request repeats an earlier one with the same `external_id` and the same body: no new order
is placed, the earlier order is returned with status 200 (a new order gives 201).

name.description: Rubric name; spaces around it are trimmed.

parent_id.description: Parent rubric of the site tree (`rubric/list`); null — a root rubric.

slug.description: URL slug: lowercase Latin letters and digits separated by single hyphens; a taken one gives 422. Without it the slug is made from the name, and a taken one gets a numeric suffix (`-two`).

position.description: Order among the siblings, ascending; after the last sibling by default (its position + 10).

partner_tag.description: Partner tag; an empty string means no tag.

selection.description: A selection (a rubric built by a filter): changing it recalculates primary rubrics of products.

unfold.description: Children are unfolded in the menu.

unfold_count.description: How many children are unfolded, 5 by default.

auto_landing.description: Auto landing pages by brands and aspects.

auto_landing_on_index.description: Auto landing pages are shown on the index page.

auto_landing_in_catalog.description: Auto landing pages are shown in the catalogue.

doc_template_id.description: Document template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.

layout_template_id.description: Layout template of the site; 0 — remove the assignment.

translations.description: Translations to change, by locale of the site.

seo.description: Description and meta to change, by site variation.

name.description: Theme name; spaces around are trimmed. Without `slug` it must give a slug: Latin letters or digits after transliteration (`!!!` gives 422).

slug.description: Slug unique in the site; from the name by default.

id.description: Address id: pass it as `address_id` to the checkout.

country.description: Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case.

city.description: Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`; outside Russia — the name as passed.

city_id.description: Settlement KLADR id (Russia); `null` outside Russia or for a settlement passed by name.

phone.description: Recipient phone with the country code, digits only.

street.description: Street; outside Russia — the address line (street, house, building).

country.description: Country of the address, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, one of the countries the site delivers to (`dictionary/country/list`); by default `RU`. The checkout delivers to this country and prices the cart for it.

city_id.description: Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search`, Russia only; in Russia `city_id` or `city_name` is required.

city_name.description: Settlement name, e.g. `Almaty`; required outside Russia, in Russia — for places without a KLADR id.

region.description: Region (state, province) outside Russia, as text; in Russia it comes from KLADR.

email.description: Recipient email; omitted — the email of the customer. The checkout skips addresses without an email.

zip.description: Postal code; omitted on update — stays as it is.

id.description: Cart id, it is also the checkout id; `null` — the cart is not created yet.

currency.description: Currency of prices.

items.description: Items in the order they were added. Items without an offer are removed when the cart is read.

selected_price.description: Price of the selected units, decimal string; delivery is calculated at the checkout.

id.description: Cart item id: the key of `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-cart/item/delete`.

offer_id.description: Offer id the item is bought from (warehouse of the variation chosen by the cart); for support requests.

name.description: Product name in the language of `site_variation`, the same as `name` of `stock/product/show`.

variation.description: Variation parameters as text, e.g. `Size: M`; `null` — the product has no variation parameters.

url.description: Absolute URL of the product page on the storefront of `site_variation`, as `url` of `stock/product/show`.

price.description: Price per unit in the cart currency, decimal string.

available_quantity.description: Units in stock that can be ordered now, as `quantity` of the variation in `stock/list`; `quantity` above it gives 422 in `customer-cart/item/update` and `customer-order/create`.

currency.description: Currency of prices.

address_id.description: Chosen address id from the address book; its country is the country of delivery and of the prices.

packages.description: Packages: selected cart items split by warehouse.

total.description: Total of all packages after the promo code discount, decimal string: the amount `customer-order/create` charges.

deliverable.description: `true` — every package is `available` (delivery method chosen, its pick-up point chosen, items in stock): `customer-order/create` is possible once an address is chosen (`address_id`). `false` — see `unavailable_reason` of the packages; no packages at all — nothing can be delivered to the address (`undeliverable_cart_item_ids`).

undeliverable_cart_item_ids.description:
Selected cart items left out of the packages: no delivery method of the site takes them to the address (country,
warehouse, weight) or they cannot be bought now. They are not ordered; remove them or unselect them in
`customer-cart/item/update`, or choose another address.

promo_discount.description: Promo code discount on items and delivery, decimal string, already subtracted from `total`; `0.00` without a code.

id.description: Package id: pass it as `package_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update` and `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`. It changes with the items of the cart: take it from the latest checkout.

warehouse_country.description: Country of the warehouse the package is shipped from, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case, as `warehouse_country` in `stock/*`.

destination_country.description: Country of delivery, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: the country of the chosen address, otherwise the country of the request.

available.description: `true` — the package can be ordered: a delivery method is chosen, its pick-up point is chosen when the method needs one, the items are in stock.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the package cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_delivery_method` — no method delivers it to the address; `pick_up_point_required` — pass `pick_up_point_id` from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`; `out_of_stock` — lower the quantity of an item to its `available_quantity`.

items_price.description: Price of the items, decimal string.

delivery_price.description: Delivery price of the chosen method, decimal string.

total.description: Total of the package, decimal string.

delivery_options.description: Delivery methods of the package; the chosen one has `selected: true`.

pick_up_point_id.description: Pick-up point chosen by the customer for a pick-up method; `null` — none chosen (the checkout does not pick one silently).

delivery_method_id.description: Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.

name.description: Name.

type.description: `courier` or `pick_up_point`: a pick-up point is chosen with `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list`.

price.description: Delivery price, decimal string in the checkout currency.

delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery date as text in the language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display.

delivery_date_iso.description: Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.

currency.description: Order currency.

total_price.description: Total of the active items including delivery, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.

delivery_price.description: Delivery price, decimal string; `0.00` once the order is canceled.

is_paid.description: Whether the order is paid. There is no notification about the payment: poll `customer-order/show`.

payment_url.description:
Payment page of the site while the order is not paid and not canceled, otherwise `null`: the customer picks
the payment method there. The link does not expire: open it again to retry a failed payment. After the bank
the customer goes to `return_url` of `customer-order/create` (kept 30 days), without it stays on the site.

payment_method.description: Payment method: the payment system of the payment, before it — the one chosen at checkout; `null` — none chosen.

status_history.description:
Status changes from the oldest: the order entered `status` at `at`. The history may lag behind `status` by a few
minutes; empty when it is not recorded yet or temporarily unavailable.

country.description: Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. `RU`.

city.description: Settlement with its type, e.g. `г Москва`.

name.description: Product name at the moment of the order.

price.description: Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.

image.description: Product image saved with the order, absolute URL; `null` — the product had no image.

status.description: Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.

tracking.description: Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.

delivery_method.description: Delivery method name in the language of `site_variation`.

pick_up_point_id.description: Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.

pick_up_point_address.description: Address of the pick-up point, `null` for courier delivery.

address.description: Delivery address and recipient; `null` — the package has no address.

passport_status.description:
Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review,
`confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.

passport_link.description: Link to the passport form for the recipient; `null` — no passport is needed now.

name.description: Name in the language of `site_variation` (in `order/*` — the main language of the site); the id when the site has no name for it.

payment_url.description: Payment page of the site for the chosen payment method.

status.description: Order status entered, the values of `status`.

at.description: When the order entered the status.

id.description: Payment method id: pass it as `payment_method_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.

name.description: Name.

id.description: Pick-up point id: pass it as `pick_up_point_id` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`; the same integer as `pick_up_point_id` of the checkout package.

price.description: Delivery price to the point, decimal string.

selected.description: Chosen by the customer for the package (`pick_up_point_id` of the package); no point is chosen silently.

name.description: Full name as stored: last, first and middle name.

first_name.description: First name: the second word of `name`.

last_name.description: Last name: the first word of `name`.

middle_name.description: Middle name: the third word of `name`.

city_id.description: City (KLADR id) used for delivery options when no address is chosen.

default_address_id.description: Default address from the address book.

token.description: Customer token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`; `null` — confirm the sign-in with the SMS code first.

expires_in.description: Seconds the customer token is valid; `null` with `confirmation_id`.

refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds the refresh token is valid; `null` with `confirmation_id`.

confirmation_id.description: Confirmation id for `customer-auth/confirm`; `null` when the tokens are issued at once.

code_lifetime.description: Seconds before a new code may be requested.

confirmation_id.description: Confirmation id for `customer-auth/confirm`, e.g. `email:9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015`: one-time, a new `customer-auth/sign-up` gives a new one.

code_length.description: Length of the code in the email.

code_lifetime.description: Seconds before a new code may be requested.

token.description: Customer token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`: valid for `expires_in` seconds.

expires_in.description: Seconds the customer token is valid; then get a new one with `customer-auth/refresh`.

refresh_token.description: One-time token for `customer-auth/refresh` and `customer-auth/sign-out`: keep it secret, on the server side of the site.

refresh_expires_in.description: Seconds the refresh token is valid; then the customer signs in again.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`) of the article in the response; omitted, `null` or `default` — the default variation. The flag itself is common to all variations.

rubric_id.description: Rubric id.

site_variation.description: Site variation code: delete only this variation of the article; without it — the whole article.
Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.

currency.description: Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.

locale.description: Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

confirm.description: Must be `true`: the deletion cannot be undone, the flag guards against an accidental call.

rubric_id.description: Rubric id.

id.description: Delivery method id, pass it as `delivery_method_id`.

name.description: Name in the language of `site_variation`; the name in the delivery settings when it has no translation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the delivery price on the site; `null` when the site sets none.

with_pick_up_points.description: `true` — delivery to a pick-up point (`type: pick_up_point` in `delivery/calculate`): points — `delivery/pick-up-point/list`; when `order/create` needs `pick_up_point_id` — see `order/create`.

countries.description:
Destination countries, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case: delivery countries of the site
(`dictionary/country/list`) the method has a tariff to from at least one warehouse. Never empty: a
method without destinations is not listed. Whether a particular cart can be shipped (warehouses of
the items, weight, pick-up points) — `delivery/calculate`.

name.description: Delivery method name.

reason.description:
Why the method is not priced: `city_required` — a pick-up method needs `city_id` (or `pick_up_point_id`);
`no_pick_up_points` — no active pick-up point with a price in the city, its district or region; `too_heavy` —
the cart is heavier than `max_weight_grams`; `country_not_served` — the tariff does not deliver to the
country; `warehouse_not_served` — no tariff from the warehouse of an item (a cart from several warehouses
needs a method that ships from all of them: split the cart); `city_not_served` — the site does not deliver to
the city (Crimea, Sevastopol); `not_priced` — the tariff refused for another reason (an item it does not
take, e.g. tyres).

max_weight_grams.description: Maximum parcel weight of the method, grams; `null` when unknown.

delivery_method_id.description: Delivery method id: pass it as `delivery_method_id` to `order/create`.

name.description: Delivery method name.

type.description: `courier` — to the door; `pick_up_point` — to a pick-up point: pass `pick_up_point_id` from `delivery/pick-up-point/list` to `order/create`.

price.description:
Delivery price, decimal string in `currency`. `courier` — the price of the order. `pick_up_point` with
`pick_up_point_id` in the request — the price to that point (the order to it is charged the same); without it —
the highest price among the points found for `city_id` (`price_is_upper_bound: true`): a particular point may be
cheaper. `"0.00"` is a valid price.

currency.description: Price currency.

price_is_upper_bound.description: `true` — `price` is the highest price among the pick-up points of the city, not the price to a particular point.

delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery date as text in the primary language of the site, e.g. `12 ноября`; for display. The latest date over the warehouses of the items.

delivery_date_iso.description: Estimated delivery date, `YYYY-MM-DD`; for sorting and comparison.

weight_grams.description: Weight of all items the tariff priced, grams (unit weight of each product times its quantity).

max_weight_grams.description: Maximum parcel weight of the method, grams; a heavier cart is omitted with `too_heavy`.

options.description: Priced delivery options, cheapest first. Empty — no method of the site delivers these items there (see `omitted`).

omitted.description:
Delivery methods enabled on the site that are not priced for this cart, with the reason: together with `options`
they are all methods of the site.

kind.description: Kind: a page type (`rubric` — catalog pages, `product` — product card) or `layout` — a wrapper with `{{ content }}`.

name.description: Template name.

global.description: Shared template of the platform: can be read and assigned, `update` and `delete` give 409.

active.description: Active: an inactive template is skipped on the storefront.

kind.description: Kind: a page type (`rubric` — catalog pages, `product` — product card) or `layout` — a wrapper with `{{ content }}`.

name.description: Template name.

global.description: Shared template of the platform: can be read and assigned, `update` and `delete` give 409.

active.description: Active: an inactive template is skipped on the storefront.

html.description: HTML with block placeholders `<template data-block-id="N">`; a layout has `{{ content }}`.

context.description: Settings and bindings of the blocks, a JSON object: `{"blocks": {"N": {"props": …, "binding": …}}}` (an empty object nested in it comes back as `[]`); `null` — not set.

token.description: Guest token for `X-Customer-Auth-Token`: opens `customer-cart/show` and `customer-cart/item/*`, valid for `expires_in` seconds. Pass it as `guest_token` to `customer-auth/confirm` (after `sign-in` by phone or `sign-up`) or to `customer-auth/sign-in` by email and password to keep the cart.

expires_in.description: Seconds the guest token is valid; renew it before with `customer-auth/guest` and the guest token.

guest_token.description: Current guest token to renew: the new token keeps its cart. Leave it out for a new guest with an empty cart.

product_ids.description: Product ids of the common catalog, 1 to 1000 — not only products of the site: a linked product becomes a product of the site. A repeated id is linked once, an unknown id is returned in `rejected_product_ids`.

rubric_ids.description: Rubric ids of the site tree (`rubric/list`), 1 to 100: the products are linked to each of them and to all their ancestors.
Rubrics the products are linked to: each requested rubric followed by its ancestors from the root.

name.description: Name in the language of the site variation, the source name if there is no translation; the same `name` as in `aspects` of products.

type.description: Special aspect of the storefront: `size` — sizes (a size picker, values from small to large, a size chart), `color` — colours (values may have `color_hex_code`); `null` — an ordinary aspect.

aspect_group_id.description: Aspect group id (`aspect/group/list`); 0 is the virtual «General characteristics» group for an aspect without a group.

aspect_group.description: Aspect group name in the language of the site variation.

id.description: Aspect group id; 0 is the virtual group for aspects without a group.

name.description: Name in the language of the site variation; the source name if there is no translation.

position.description: Order of the groups, ascending; groups with the same position go by `id`.

name.description: Value in the language of the site variation, the source value if there is no translation; the same `name` as in `params` of products.

color_hex_code.description: Colour of the value as `#RRGGBB` for a colour swatch, the same as the storefront filter shows; `null` — no colour is set (most values, including most values of `color` aspects).

rubric_id.description: Rubric id.

parent_id.description: New parent rubric of the site tree (`rubric/list`); null — make it a root rubric.

position.description: Order among the new siblings, ascending (`position` of `rubric/list`); without it — after the last sibling. With the same parent only the position changes.

currency.description: Currency: `RUB`, `USD`, `EUR`.

type.description: `order_charge` — paid for an order (negative), `order_refund` — returned for an order (positive), `voucher` — a partner voucher, `adjustment` — a top-up or correction by an operator, `other` — other accruals (bonuses).

amount.description: Signed amount, decimal string: negative — charged from the deposit, positive — added to it.

currency.description: Currency of the amount: `RUB`, `USD`, `EUR`.

created_at.description: When the operation was made; null for old operations without a date.

order_id.description: Order id (`order/show`) for `order_charge` and `order_refund`; null — not related to an order.

note.description: Comment of the operator as written, often in Russian; null — none.

price.description:
Sale price per unit in `currency`, decimal string, the same as `items[].price` of `order/create`. The free
delivery threshold of a tariff is checked against the cart total, so pass the prices you will order at; without
it (or with `0`) the price of the variation on the site is used, as in `order/create` without `price`.

customer.description: Customer of the site who placed the order; `null` for an order placed by the partner (`source: partner`).

currency.description: Order currency, e.g. `RUB`.

total_price.description: Current total of the active items including delivery, decimal string in the order currency.

delivery_price.description: Current delivery price, decimal string in the order currency; `0.00` once the order is canceled.

is_paid.description: Whether the order is paid (by the customer or from the partner deposit); stays `true` after cancellation.

payment_method.description:
Payment method: the payment system that took the payment, before payment — the one chosen at checkout;
`null` — not chosen (an order paid from the deposit has none). `name` is in the main language of the site.

deposit_paid.description:
Charged from the partner deposit by `order/pay`, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`;
`null` — not paid from the deposit. Cancellation does not change it.

deposit_refunded.description:
Returned to the deposit for this order, decimal string in `deposit_currency`: cancellation does not return
the deposit, an operator does. `0.00` — nothing returned yet; `null` — not paid from the deposit.

deposit_due.description: What `order/pay` would charge from the deposit now, delivery included, decimal string in `deposit_currency`.

external_id.description: Order id in the partner system passed to `order/create`.

name.description: Name from the customer profile.

product_variation_id.description: Product variation id, the one passed to `order/create`.

name.description: Product name at the moment of the order.

price.description: Price per unit in the order currency, decimal string.

Sale price per unit in the order currency, decimal string. It may not be lower than the
price of the variation on the site; without it the site price is used.

pick_up_point_id.description: Pick-up point id, `null` for courier delivery.

address.description: Delivery address and recipient as of the order; for a pick-up point — the recipient with the address of the point.

tracking.description: Tracking number, `null` until the package is sent.

status.description: Package status, the same values as the order status; `null` until the warehouse sets it.

passport_status.description:
Passport of the recipient required by customs: `missing` — not filled, `pending` — under review,
`confirmed`, `problem` — rejected, fill in again; `null` — the delivery method needs no passport.

passport_link.description: Link to the passport form: send it to the recipient, who fills in the passport; `null` — no passport is needed now.

name.description: First name.

phone.description:
Phone with the country code: 10 to 15 digits. Spaces, `+`, `-`, `.` and brackets are allowed and dropped,
`+7 (900) 000-00-00` is stored as `79000000000`; letters and other characters give 422.

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from `POST /v2/dictionary/country/list`, in any case (`ru` and `RU` are the same).

city.description: City (Russia), e.g. `Москва`; may be omitted with `city_id`. Outside Russia — the city of the address.

address.description: Full address in one line (outside Russia).

city_id.description:
Settlement KLADR id from `dictionary/city/search` (Russia only), the same `city_id` as in `delivery/calculate` and
`delivery/pick-up-point/list`: the delivery price and the pick-up point chosen without `pick_up_point_id` are taken
for it, as `delivery/calculate` showed. It wins over the settlement the address service finds by `city` and
`street`; without `city` the name of the settlement is taken from KLADR. Without `city_id` the settlement is the
one the address service finds by `city` and `street`, or none.

deposit_currency.description: Deposit currency to charge; by default the order currency.

id.description: Pick-up point id: pass it as `pick_up_point_id` to `order/create` and `delivery/calculate`.

name.description: Name given by the delivery network, e.g. `MSK305, Москва, ул. Душинская`.

type.description: `point` — regular pick-up point, `postamat` — parcel locker, `terminal` — terminal; `null` if the network did not report it.

schedule.description: Opening hours as the network reports them.

city_id.description: KLADR id of the settlement of the point: may differ from `city_id` of the request when the city has no points (see the operation).

price.description: Delivery price of the items of the request to the point, decimal string in `currency` — what `order/create` with this point charges; `null` without `product_variation_ids` or when the tariff does not price this point.

currency.description: Currency of `price`; `null` when `price` is `null`.

name.description: Aspect name in the language of the variation.

type.description: Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.

aspect_group_id.description: Aspect group id (`aspect/group/list`), as in `aspect/batch-show`: a filter panel can group the aspects without more requests.

aspect_group.description: Aspect group name in the language of the variation.

values.description: Values with the number of products, up to 200, in the order of the storefront filter: sizes from small to large (`XS`, `S`, `M` …, numbers ascending; a size the storefront does not know goes last), other aspects — most products first; selected values (`param_ids`) are always here, with 0 when nothing has them. Counts take every filter into account except the values of this aspect.

name.description: Aspect name.

type.description: Special aspect of the storefront, as `type` of `aspect/batch-show`: `size`, `color` or `null`.

role.description: `variant` — its values tell the variations apart (size, colour): `param_ids` of the variations; `property` — a property of the product or of a variation (material, country): `property_param_ids`.

id.description: Brand id: pass it in `brand_ids` of `stock/product/search`.

name.description: Brand name.

count.description: Number of products of the selection of this brand, by the search index.

selected.description: The brand is in `brand_ids` of the request.

aspects.description: Aspects of the selection with their values: the filter aspects of `rubric_id`; without a rubric — the default filter aspects of the storefront; with `query` — any aspects of the found products. Up to 50 aspects, most used first.

brands.description: Brands of the selection, up to 100, most products first; the counts do not take `brand_ids` into account.

price.description: Price range of the selection without `price_from` and `price_to`; `null` — nothing is found.

rubrics.description: Main rubrics of the products of the selection, up to 100, most products first — the categories of a brand page or a search; the counts do not take `rubric_id` and `rubric_ids` into account.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor of the next page for `cursor`; null — this page is the last one.

locale.description: Language of the texts.

site_variations.description: Codes of the site variations in this language (`settings/site-variation/list`); empty — the site has texts in a language none of its variations uses now.

product.description: Site texts of the product in this language, as `product/update` answers; a `null` field is not set by the site.

variations.description: Site texts of the variations that have at least one in this language, by id, as `product/variation/update` answers; a variation not listed has none.

common.description: With `with_source`: the common translation of the product in this language — the storefront shows it where the site text is not set; a `null` field has no translation, the storefront shows `source`. `null` without `with_source`.

id.description: Param id: pass it in `param_ids` of `stock/product/search`.

name.description: Value in the language of the variation.

count.description: Number of products of the selection with this value, by the search index.

selected.description: The value is in `param_ids` of the request.

color_hex_code.description: Colour of the value as `#RRGGBB` for a colour swatch, as in `aspect/param/batch-show`; `null` — no colour is set.

name.description: Param value.

aspect_id.description: Aspect id from `aspects` of the product.

min.description: Lowest price, decimal string: a value for `price_from`.

max.description: Highest price, decimal string: a value for `price_to`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the primary currency of the site: the currency of the search index prices, of `price_from` and `price_to`; live prices of `stock/product/search` are in the currency of the variation.

id.description: Rubric id: pass it in `rubric_ids` of `stock/product/search`.

name.description: Name in the language of `site_variation`.

count.description: Number of products of the selection with this main rubric, by the search index.

selected.description: The rubric is in `rubric_id` or `rubric_ids` of the request.

name.description: Name; null — not set (no translation in this language).

description.description: Description, HTML; null — not set (no translation in this language).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the prices.

variations.description: Variations of the product on the site — the same set as `variations` of `stock/product/show` (or the requested ones of them), each with its price and stock.

locale.description: Language of the texts (the language of `site_variation`).

name.description: Name of the product on the site; null — not set by the site: the storefront shows the common translation or the original name.

description.description: Description of the product on the site, HTML; null — not set by the site.

meta_title.description: SEO title of the product page; null — not set by the site.

meta_description.description: SEO meta description of the product page; null — not set by the site.

meta_keywords.description: SEO meta keywords of the product page; null — not set by the site.

meta_robots.description: Meta robots of the product page: `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW` or `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW`; null — not set by the site (the storefront uses `INDEX, FOLLOW`).

source.description: With `with_source`: name and description of the catalog, without translations and site texts — the storefront shows them where there is neither; `null` without `with_source`.

locales.description: Texts by language: the languages of the site variations first (the default variation first), then other languages the site has texts of the product in; with `site_variation` — its language only.

locale.description: Language of the texts (the language of `site_variation`).

name.description: Name of the variation on the site; null — not set by the site: the storefront shows the name of the product on the site, the common translation or the original name.

description.description: Description of the variation on the site; null — not set by the site.

id.description: Product variation id. Its page on the site is `url` of the product with `#v<id>`.

description.description: Variation description, the source text.

price.description: Current price of the site in `currency` of the product, decimal string with 2 digits after the point (`"1990.00"`); `null` — the site has no active offer for the variation in the country (`unavailable_reason` is `no_offer`). The price stays when only the stock is the problem.

old_price.description: Price before the discount in `currency` of the product; `null` when there is no discount (no old price, or it is not above `price`).

quantity.description: Stock that can be ordered now; 0 when `available` is false.

available.description: Can be ordered now: there is an offer, stock and no limit applies.

unavailable_reason.description: Why the variation cannot be ordered, `null` when `available` is true: `no_offer` — no active offer of the site for the country (no price), `out_of_stock` — the offer has no stock, `price_over_limit` — the price is over the limit of the warehouse, `weight_over_limit` — the weight is over the limit of Russian Post for prices in RUB.

images.description: Image URLs, the first is the main one.

param_ids.description: Ids of the params that tell the variations apart (aspects with role `variant`: size, colour), from `params` of the product. Two variations can have the same set when the variation aspects of the product are not filled in: tell them apart by `id`, `vendor_id` and `price`.

property_param_ids.description: Ids of property params of this variation that are not in `property_param_ids` of the product, from `params` of the product.

warehouse_country.description: Country of the warehouse of the offer, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 in upper case; `null` without an offer.

vendor_id.description: Vendor id (S) of the offer; `null` without an offer. Offers of one product may come from different vendors.

external_sku.description: SKU of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.

name.description: Product name in the language of `locale`; the source name when the product has no translation.

description.description: Product description, HTML, in the language of `locale`; the source text when it has no translation in that language.

locale.description: Language of the translation in `name` and `description`: the language of `site_variation` or of its fallback chain; `null` — no translation, both are source texts (often Russian or English).

slug.description: Slug of the product page on the site.

url.description: Absolute URL of the product page on the site for `site_variation` (its subdomain or folder); a variation is opened with `#v<variation id>`.

primary_rubric_id.description: Primary rubric of the site rubric tree.

rubric_ids.description: Rubrics of the site rubric tree the product is in, ascending: the rubrics it is linked to and all their ancestors — the same meaning as `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` and `stock/product/search` (a rubric with its subrubrics).

available.description: At least one variation can be ordered now; false — show the product as sold out or hide it (always false without `variations`).

closed.description: The product is in the site tree but closed for the site in the country of the request: by the country, the brand or rubric restrictions of the site, a manual denial or an inactive product. It has no `variations` and cannot be sold; hide it on the storefront. It stays in `stock/product/id/list` until `product/rubric/unlink`, its texts can still be written.

min_price.description: Lowest `price` among the variations that can be ordered now, decimal string; `null` — none can be ordered.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of all prices of the product.

image.description: Main image URL: the first image of the first variation that can be ordered, otherwise of the first variation; `null` — no images.

external_id.description: Product id of the external system, only for sites with their own catalogue.

property_param_ids.description: Ids of property params shared by all variations, from `params`; the own properties of a variation are in its `property_param_ids`.

variations.description: Variations of the product on the site, the same set and prices as `stock/list`: only variations with images and at least one offer. Empty — the product cannot be sold now (`available: false`, `min_price` and usually `image` are `null`): keep it hidden on the storefront; it comes back when a variation gets an offer, or when the site opens it (`closed`).

aspects.description: Aspects used by `params`, with `role`: `variant` aspects tell the variations apart, `property` aspects describe them.

params.description: Params (aspect values) used by the product and its variations.

site_variation.description: Site variation code (`settings/site-variation/list`): language, country and currency of prices; the default variation if omitted.

country.description: Override of the country of the variation, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; must be allowed on the site.

currency.description: Override of the currency; must be allowed for the country.

locale.description: Override of the language of names, e.g. `ru`.

site_variation.description: Site variation of `variation` variables; `default` — the variation without a code.

name.description: Rubric name, as `name` of `rubric/list`.

locale.description: Locale, e.g. `ru`.

description.description: Description, HTML.

locale.description: Locale of the site, e.g. `ru`.

h1.description: Page heading (h1); an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

description.description: Description, HTML; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

meta_title.description: Meta title; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

meta_description.description: Meta description; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

meta_keywords.description: Meta keywords; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

meta_robots.description: Meta robots: one of `INDEX, FOLLOW`, `INDEX, NOFOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, FOLLOW`, `NOINDEX, NOFOLLOW` (any case and order, `noindex,follow` too; stored in this form); omitted or `null` — unchanged, empty string — reset.

meta_lead.description: Lead text under the heading; an empty string (or only spaces) clears it, spaces around are trimmed.

rubric_id.description: Rubric id of the site tree.

translations.description: Texts of the site, one entry for each language of the site; a field without a text is null.
