ResponseUsage.description: Request rate limit after this request: a sliding window of 1 minute, counted per API group and per token owner (the site or the customer in Site API, the user in AdminApi); requests without a token are counted per client IP and User-Agent.

limit.description: Requests allowed per window of 1 minute.

used.description: Requests counted in the current window.

remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

retry_after.description: Seconds until the next request is accepted, 0 while `remaining` is above zero.

Problem.description: Problem Details for HTTP APIs (RFC 9457). Always sent as `application/problem+json`.

error.description: Always `true` in an error; `false` in a successful response.

type.description:
Stable identifier of the problem type: branch on it, not on `detail`. A URI reference relative to the API host: `GET` it for the page of the type (HTML, or JSON with `Accept: application/json`), all types — `/api/problems`.

- [`/api/problems/bad-request`](/api/problems/bad-request) — 400, **Malformed request**. The request cannot be read: the body is not valid JSON or not a JSON object, or a parameter has an empty or malformed value. When: Any operation, before the request reaches business rules. Fix: Send a JSON object with `Content-Type: application/json` and check the part named in `detail`. The same request will fail again.
- [`/api/problems/unauthorized`](/api/problems/unauthorized) — 401, **Authentication required**. The request has no token, or the token is not accepted: unknown, disabled, of another site, or an expired customer token. When: Any operation except the documentation. The site token goes in `X-Auth-Token`, the customer token in `X-Customer-Auth-Token`. Fix: Pass the token the operation expects: the site token in `X-Auth-Token`, the customer token in `X-Customer-Auth-Token` (`detail` names it). A disabled site token stays rejected: ask 4Partners support for a new one. An expired customer token: renew it with `customer-auth/refresh`; a revoked one (sign-out, password change, disabled site token): sign the customer in again with `customer-auth/sign-in`.
- [`/api/problems/forbidden`](/api/problems/forbidden) — 403, **Access denied**. The token is valid but does not open this operation, or the site cannot do it. When: A customer token on a site operation or the other way round: `customer-account/*`, `customer-cart/*` and `customer-order/*` need `X-Customer-Auth-Token`, the rest need the site token. Orders and the deposit of a site without a partner owner. Fix: Call the operation with the token it expects (`security` of the operation in the specification). A site without an owner: contact 4Partners support.
- [`/api/problems/not-found`](/api/problems/not-found) — 404, **Resource not found**. The object with this id does not exist or belongs to another site (the two are not told apart), or the path is unknown. When: Operations that take an id (`order_id`, `product_id`, `rubric_id` and others), and any unknown path. Fix: Take the id from a list operation of the same site (`order/list`, `stock/product/id/list`, `rubric/list`…) and check the path in the specification. The same id will not be found again.
- [`/api/problems/method-not-allowed`](/api/problems/method-not-allowed) — 405, **Method not allowed**. The path exists, but not for this HTTP method. The `Allow` header lists the allowed methods. When: Any operation called not with `POST`: every Site API operation is `POST` with a JSON body. Fix: Send `POST` with a JSON body.
- [`/api/problems/not-acceptable`](/api/problems/not-acceptable) — 406, **Response format not acceptable**. The response format asked for in `Accept` is not supported: the API answers JSON only. When: Any operation with `Accept` that does not allow JSON. Fix: Send `Accept: application/json` or leave the header out.
- [`/api/problems/conflict`](/api/problems/conflict) — 409, **Conflict with the current state**. The request is valid, but the current state of the object does not allow it. When: Deleting a rubric with child rubrics, deleting a page article (main, 404), canceling an order placed by a customer, and similar. Fix: Do what `detail` says first (for example, move the child rubrics), then repeat. The same request will get the same answer.
- [`/api/problems/unsupported-media-type`](/api/problems/unsupported-media-type) — 415, **Unsupported request format**. The body format in `Content-Type` is not supported: the API reads JSON only. When: Any operation with a body. Fix: Send the body as JSON with `Content-Type: application/json`.
- [`/api/problems/validation-error`](/api/problems/validation-error) — 422, **Request validation failed**. Values of the request are invalid. Each one is listed in `errors`: `pointer` (JSON Pointer to the value in the body) or `parameter` (query parameter) and `detail`: what is wrong and what to pass. Branch on `pointer`, not on the text. When: Any operation with a body: a required field is missing, a value has a wrong type or is out of range, a key is unknown. Fix: Fix every value listed in `errors` and send again. Branch on `pointer`, not on `detail`.
- [`/api/problems/too-many-requests`](/api/problems/too-many-requests) — 429, **Too many requests**. The rate limit is exceeded. `usage` has the limit and how much is used, `Retry-After` — seconds to wait. When: Any operation: the limit is per site (all its tokens share it) and operation group; per customer in customer groups. Fix: Wait `Retry-After` seconds and repeat. Use batch operations (`stock/product/batch-show`, `stock/list`, `order/batch-show`) instead of many single calls.
- [`/api/problems/internal-error`](/api/problems/internal-error) — 500, **Internal server error**. The server failed to process the request; a change may or may not have been made. `request_id` identifies the request in our logs. When: Any operation, on an unexpected failure. Fix: Repeat later with a growing pause. Before repeating a change, read the object (for example, `order/show`) so as not to do it twice. If it repeats, send `request_id` to 4Partners support.
- [`/api/problems/business-rule`](/api/problems/business-rule) — 422, **Rejected by a business rule**. The request is valid, but a business rule rejects it. `detail` names the rule and what to change, `pointer` (if present) — the value of the body. When: Write operations and some reads: a product variation not on the site, a quantity above the stock, a country the site does not deliver to, nothing to update. Fix: Change the request as `detail` says. The same request will be rejected again.
- [`/api/problems/subscription-expired`](/api/problems/subscription-expired) — 403, **Subscription of the site owner has expired**. The subscription of the site owner has expired: partner orders are not placed. When: `order/create`. Fix: Renew the subscription in the 4Partners partner account, then repeat. A repeat with the `external_id` of an order created before still returns that order.
- [`/api/problems/owner-not-allowed`](/api/problems/owner-not-allowed) — 403, **Site owner is not allowed to place orders**. The site owner is not allowed to place partner orders on this site. When: `order/create`. Fix: Ask 4Partners support to allow orders for the site owner.
- [`/api/problems/deposit-insufficient`](/api/problems/deposit-insufficient) — 409, **Not enough deposit**. The deposit of the site owner has not enough money to pay the order. Nothing was charged. When: `order/pay`. Fix: Top up the deposit by at least the difference in `detail` (balance — `balance/show`, amount to pay — `deposit_due` of `order/show`), then repeat `order/pay`.
- [`/api/problems/order-already-paid`](/api/problems/order-already-paid) — 409, **Order is already paid**. The order is already paid: it is not charged again, and the customer cannot cancel it. When: `order/pay`; `customer-order/cancel` of a paid order. Fix: `order/pay`: nothing to do, the payment is done (`deposit_paid` of `order/show` shows the charged amount). `customer-order/cancel`: the customer cannot cancel a paid order; the shop cancels it and refunds the payment.
- [`/api/problems/order-canceled`](/api/problems/order-canceled) — 409, **Order is canceled**. The order is canceled and cannot be paid. When: `order/pay`. Fix: Place a new order with `order/create` (with a new `external_id`).
- [`/api/problems/order-shipped`](/api/problems/order-shipped) — 409, **Order is shipped**. The order is sent to the recipient or delivered, so the partner cannot cancel it. When: `order/cancel` of an order with status `sent`, `sent_msk` or `delivered`. Fix: The order is on its way: ask 4Partners support to arrange a return.
- [`/api/problems/price-below-site-price`](/api/problems/price-below-site-price) — 422, **Price is below the site price**. The price of an item is below the current price of the product on the site. `pointer` names the item. When: `order/create` with `price` in an item. Fix: Leave `price` out (or pass `0`) to use the site price, or pass a price not lower than the current one from `stock/list`.
- [`/api/problems/pick-up-point-required`](/api/problems/pick-up-point-required) — 422, **Pick-up point required**. The delivery method delivers to pick-up points, but `pick_up_point_id` is missing and no point was chosen automatically. When: `order/create`; `customer-order/create` when a package of the checkout has a pick-up method without a chosen point. Fix: Pass `pick_up_point_id` from `delivery/pick-up-point/list` for this delivery method; on the customer path — from `customer-cart/pick-up-point/list` to `customer-cart/checkout/update`.
- [`/api/problems/external-id-conflict`](/api/problems/external-id-conflict) — 409, **Order with this external id differs**. An order with this `external_id` already exists and differs from the request (items, delivery method, pick-up point or currency). A repeat with the same body returns the existing order with `replayed`. When: `order/create` with `external_id`. Fix: A new order needs a new `external_id`. The existing order: `order/show` with the id from `detail`.
- [`/api/problems/delivery-unavailable`](/api/problems/delivery-unavailable) — 422, **Delivery method cannot deliver**. The delivery method cannot carry this order or product: the parcel is heavier than the tariff allows, the method does not deliver to the country, or it does not ship from the warehouse of an item. `pointer` names the value to change. When: `order/create`, `order/pay` (the tariff is checked again at payment), `delivery/calculate`, `customer-cart/item/create`. Fix: Choose another method from `delivery/calculate` for the same items and country, or split the order. An order that cannot be paid: cancel it with `order/cancel` and place it again with another method. Nothing was charged.
- [`/api/problems/country-not-delivered`](/api/problems/country-not-delivered) — 422, **Site does not deliver to the country**. The country of the request is not among the delivery countries of the site. `pointer` names the field with the country. When: `delivery/calculate`, `order/create`, `dictionary/city/search`. Fix: Take a country from `dictionary/country/list`.
- [`/api/problems/variation-unavailable`](/api/problems/variation-unavailable) — 422, **Product variation is not sold on the site**. The product variation does not exist or has no offer of a supplier of the site, so it cannot be priced, delivered or ordered. `pointer` names the item. When: `delivery/calculate`, `delivery/pick-up-point/list` with items, `order/create`. Fix: Remove the item or take product variation ids from `stock/product/show` or `stock/list`.
- [`/api/problems/delivery-method-not-on-site`](/api/problems/delivery-method-not-on-site) — 422, **Delivery method is not enabled on the site**. The delivery method exists but is not enabled on the site: the site has no tariff for it. `pointer` — `delivery_method_id`. When: `delivery/pick-up-point/list`, `order/create`. Fix: Take `delivery_method_id` from `dictionary/delivery-method/list` or `delivery/calculate`.
- [`/api/problems/pick-up-not-supported`](/api/problems/pick-up-not-supported) — 422, **Delivery method has no pick-up points**. The delivery method delivers to the door, while the request is about pick-up points. `pointer` names the field to change. When: `delivery/pick-up-point/list` with a door delivery method, `order/create` with `pick_up_point_id` and a door delivery method. Fix: For pick-up points take a method with `with_pick_up_points: true` (`type: pick_up_point` in `delivery/calculate`); with a door method leave `pick_up_point_id` out.
- [`/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree`](/api/problems/rubric-not-in-tree) — 422, **Rubric is not in the tree**. The rubric is not a rubric of the tree the operation works with (the site tree, or the tree of the source store of `store_id`): it belongs to another tree, or it does not exist. `pointer` names the rubric in the body. When: `product/rubric/link`, `product/rubric/unlink`, `product/primary-rubric/update`; `rubric_id` of `stock/product/search`, `stock/facet/list`, `stock/product/id/list`, `rubric/aspect/list`, `rubric/brand/show`, `rubric/brand/update`; `parent_id` of `rubric/create`, `rubric/move`, `rubric/list`, `rubric/search`; `parent_id` of `source/store-rubric/list` and `rubric_id` of `stock/product/id/list` with `store_id` — the tree of the source store. Fix: Take rubric ids from `rubric/list` or `rubric/search`, rubrics of a source store — from `source/store-rubric/list` with the same `store_id`.
- [`/api/problems/rubric-inactive`](/api/problems/rubric-inactive) — 422, **Rubric is inactive**. The rubric of the site tree is inactive, and the operation needs an active one: an inactive rubric is not shown on the storefront. When: `product/primary-rubric/update`: the main rubric must be shown on the storefront. `product/rubric/link` accepts an inactive rubric. Fix: Activate the rubric with `rubric/activate`, or choose an active one from `rubric/list`.
- [`/api/problems/rubric-in-use`](/api/problems/rubric-in-use) — 409, **Rubric is in use**. The rubric is used by settings of the platform that are not deleted together with it (banners, brand and supplier lists of the rubric, filters, source store links, exports): deleting it would break them. `detail` lists what uses the rubric. When: `rubric/delete`. Fix: Turn the rubric off with `rubric/deactivate` instead: it disappears from the storefront and keeps the settings. To delete it, ask the support to remove the listed settings first.
- [`/api/problems/no-products-accepted`](/api/problems/no-products-accepted) — 422, **No product can be processed**. None of `product_ids` fits the operation: the products do not exist, or (for operations on products of the site) they are not in the site tree. Nothing was changed. When: `product/rubric/link` and `product/primary-rubric/update` — no product of `product_ids` exists; `product/rubric/unlink` — none is in the site tree. Fix: Take ids of products of the site from `stock/product/id/list`, products to add to the site — from `stock/product/search` or `source/store-rubric/list`.
- [`/api/problems/site-variation-unknown`](/api/problems/site-variation-unknown) — 422, **Unknown site variation**. The site has no variation with the code passed in `site_variation`. When: Any operation with `site_variation`: products, texts, aspects, dictionaries, the customer path. Fix: Take a code from `settings/site-variation/list`, or leave `site_variation` out for the default variation.
- [`/api/problems/customer-token-required`](/api/problems/customer-token-required) — 403, **Customer token required**. The operation acts for a customer and opens only with the customer token in `X-Customer-Auth-Token`; the site token was passed instead. When: `customer-account/*`, `customer-cart/*`, `customer-order/*` called with `X-Auth-Token` and without `X-Customer-Auth-Token`. Fix: Sign the customer in with `customer-auth/sign-in` (with the site token) and pass the issued token in `X-Customer-Auth-Token`.
- [`/api/problems/site-token-required`](/api/problems/site-token-required) — 403, **Site token required**. The operation acts for the site and opens only with the site token in `X-Auth-Token`; only a customer token was passed. When: Any operation except `customer-account/*`, `customer-cart/*`, `customer-order/*` and `dictionary/*` called with `X-Customer-Auth-Token` and without `X-Auth-Token`. Fix: Pass the site token in `X-Auth-Token`; a customer token sent with it does not disturb.
- [`/api/problems/sign-in-locked`](/api/problems/sign-in-locked) — 429, **Sign-in temporarily locked**. Too many failed attempts to sign in with this email or phone (or to confirm the old password): signing in by it is locked for a while. The rate limit of operations is separate. When: `customer-auth/sign-in` by email, `customer-auth/confirm`, `customer-account/password/update` after 5 attempts without a success within 15 minutes for one email, phone or customer; sign-in by password and code — after 300 failures within 15 minutes through one site token. Fix: Wait `Retry-After` seconds. A customer who forgot the password resets it with `customer-auth/password/reset`.
- `about:blank` — any other status (for example 502): see `title` and `detail`.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type, the same for every occurrence.

status.description: HTTP status code of the response.

detail.description: Explanation of this occurrence for a human. Not meant to be parsed.

instance.description: Path of the request that caused the problem.

request_id.description: Request id, the same as the `X-Request-Id` response header. Quote it when reporting a problem.

pointer.description: Only in some business rejections (not in `/api/problems/validation-error`): JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the value of the request body the problem is about, as a URI fragment.

required.description: Only in 403: what access is missing. `kind`: `acl` (with `code` of the permission), `role` (with `role`) or `target` (the user cannot be managed by you).

ValidationProblem.description: Request validation failed: `type` is `/api/problems/validation-error`, every invalid value is listed in `errors`.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the invalid value in the request body, as a URI fragment. `#` is the whole body.

parameter.description: Name of the invalid query string parameter.

detail.description: What is wrong with the value and what to pass instead.

RateLimitProblem.description: Rate limit of the API group for the token exceeded: `type` is `/api/problems/too-many-requests`, the limit state is in `usage`.

SiteToken.description: Value for the X-Auth-Token header parameter.
SiteToken.name: X-Auth-Token

CustomerToken.description: Value for the X-Customer-Auth-Token header parameter.
CustomerToken.name: X-Customer-Auth-Token
